case.title: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH, Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o., Drehteile Fuchsreiter GmbH. RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series. Need: 4200 pc a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 35 days). There is no fallback supplier: without a deal the demand is bought at the fallback price. Must-haves: lead_time_days <= 42. Prepare from the data package.

messages.subject: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hallo,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is good to hear from you again. For this work, we can offer a price of €36.00 per unit. We have our CNC machines ready and look forward to putting this job onto the shop floor for you. 

Let me know if this works for you so we can get started soon.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Dear Mr Dralveck,

You wrote that your CNC machines are ready for this job, and that is the right starting point for the pump shaft of our new HX series. We would like to find a fair solution for both family companies, and Option A is built for that.

On quality:
Your quality was 1863 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70210@2026Q3).

On the competing offer:
Another supplier has offered EUR 31.50 for this part (offer:70240-0).

On material costs:
German producer prices for cold-drawn bars changed -2.1% from 2026-05 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).

Several bidders are competing for this part, and the award goes to the best overall package. Nothing here is promised in advance, but we would be glad to see a long-standing neighbour come out ahead.

Our proposal: unit price EUR 26.61; payment 14 days net; lead time 35 days.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives your shop a clear, steady job and a fixed price, and it reflects the cost picture above.

Hollerau and Dralveck have worked together for years, and we would like to build the HX series on that foundation.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

Hallo, I looked at your numbers on the material costs and the other quote, and you are right, things have moved. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. 

Our current defect rate for you is about 1200 ppm. We take the complaints seriously; our 8D report is attached. Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C2431, AS-14404, PPI-D351. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. 

I can come down to €30.00 per unit with these terms, which is a big step from our side to keep this business between us. So our current Angebot is a price of €30.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days. We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Dear Mr Dralveck,

You asked for faster payment, and Option A gives you exactly that, so it is the answer to your wish for quicker cash.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 26.87; payment 14 days net; lead time 35 days.
Option B: unit price EUR 28.05; payment 45 days net; lead time 35 days.

Option A is the package we can approve: it pays you fastest, and it keeps the price fair for both family companies.

Several bidders are competing for this part, and the award goes to the best overall package. We cannot promise it in advance. But we would like that package to come from a partner whose machines are ready and whose work we know.

We will pay every invoice on its agreed due date. Since you decide for your company yourself, we would be glad to hear which option you prefer.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

Two points explain where we stand.

On quality:
Your quality was 980 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70240@2026Q3).

On the alloy surcharge:
The alloy surcharge for stainless grade 316L changed -5.5% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09).

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 25.99; payment 90 days net; lead time 35 days.
Option B: unit price EUR 25.84; payment 60 days net; lead time 35 days.

Several bidders are quoting for the HX series pump shaft, and the order will go to the best overall package. We cannot promise the outcome, but we would like to see yours among the strongest.

Please let us know which option you prefer.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
